name: Conferfly
description_en:
Conferfly is a meeting-room scheduling and joining layer that connects room calendars with the web versions of conferencing platforms. It does not replace Teams, Zoom or Google Meet with its own universal meeting service.

Its desktop app includes a Chromium browser, with tablet controller and booking-panel options. Existing room hardware still needs a computer/tablet, microphone, speakers and an appropriate screen; a monitor alone cannot run the workflow.
description_zh:
Conferfly 是连接会议室日历与各会议平台网页版本的预订及加入控制层，不是用自己的通用会议服务替代 Teams、Zoom 或 Google Meet。

其桌面应用包含 Chromium 浏览器，也提供平板控制器和预订屏。现有会议室仍需电脑/平板、麦克风、扬声器及适当屏幕，仅有显示器无法运行该流程。

sections.title_en: Example: book a room and join an external call
sections.title_zh: 示例：预订房间并加入外部会议
sections.en:
The setup guide expects Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, room resources and a room computer running the app or Chrome. It describes granting calendar access and importing rooms. Create a calendar event with its video link and add the room resource; then check that the expected event and join button appear on the correct room device.

For an external invitation the guide discusses editing/duplicating the event and adding the room, then refreshing the device. A missing video link can mean no join button; supported platforms can also be joined manually with an ID. Test audio/video permissions and the intended room account rather than relying only on successful calendar sync. No calendars or device permissions were changed here.
sections.zh:
安装指南要求 Google Workspace 或 Microsoft 365、会议室资源及运行应用或 Chrome 的房间电脑，并说明日历授权和房间导入。建立含视频链接的日历活动并加入房间资源后，检查正确设备是否显示预期活动及加入按钮。

外部邀请的指南讨论编辑/复制活动、加入房间及刷新设备。缺少视频链接可能没有加入按钮，支持的平台也可手动输入 ID 加入。应测试音视频权限及预期房间账户，不能只检查日历同步成功。本次未修改日历或设备权限。

sections.title_en: Pay per room, with platform subscriptions separate
sections.title_zh: 按房间付费，会议平台订阅另核
sections.en:
The read localized pricing page lists Business at $19.99 per room/month or $199.99 annually, with a 21-day free trial, and Enterprise at $29.99 per room/month. The captured page does not explicitly identify the currency code, so no normalized currency or universal local price is supplied.

Enterprise includes room check-in/automatic release, advanced controls, customization and API access; on-premise deployment is explicitly optional. Automatic release cancels a booking if nobody checks in within the configured interval. Agree that behavior before adoption. Conferencing-platform accounts/licences and physical room equipment are separate prerequisites, not proven inclusions in the room fee.
sections.zh:
已读本地化价格页列 Business 每房间每月 $19.99 或每年 $199.99，含 21 天免费试用；Enterprise 每房间每月 $29.99。截取页未明确币种代码，因此不提供标准化币种或通用本地价格。

Enterprise 包含房间签到/自动释放、高级控制、定制及 API，本地部署明确为可选。如果配置时限内无人签到，自动释放会取消预订，采用前需约定此行为。会议平台账户/许可及实体设备是单独前提，不能认定已包含于房间费。

sections.en:
IT teams supporting mixed meeting platforms can evaluate calendar-driven rooms without replacing every existing endpoint. Teams without calendar room resources or a dedicated room device need that groundwork first. Conferfly uses platform web clients; native clients have limited automation according to its guide, so test the actual path used in production.

No device compatibility, kiosk escape resistance, calendar permissions, API, automatic cancellation or on-premise licence was independently tested. Compliance labels and vendor time-saving claims were not accepted as audit evidence or measured savings. A Chinese public page was observed; it does not establish every installed client’s interface language.
sections.zh:
支持多会议平台的 IT 团队，可评估基于日历的会议室流程，无需先替换所有终端。没有房间资源或专用设备的团队需先完成基础配置。Conferfly 使用平台网页客户端，指南说明原生客户端自动化有限，应测试生产实际采用路径。

未独立测试设备兼容、kiosk 防退出、日历权限、API、自动取消或本地部署许可。合规标签及节时宣传未当作审计证据或实测节约。已观察到中文公共页面，但不能确立所有安装客户端的界面语言。
